title: Keep typing smooth while a heavy filter runs
summary: Filtering 5000 products makes the search box stutter. Keep the input urgent and let the list fall behind.

turns.user: product search has like 5000 items and it stutters on every keystroke. will useTransition fix it

assistant.body: Great question! Let's move the filter update to a lower priority with useTransition. An update inside startTransition can be interrupted, so keystrokes are handled first even in the middle of a heavy render. While isPending is true the list is dimmed to show it is catching up.

turns.user: worse now. letters show up in bursts

assistant.body: Apologies, my previous answer was incorrect. I put query in the transition, and query is what drives the input value, so the input itself was being deferred. The React docs say it plainly: a state variable that controls an input cannot be updated in a Transition. The urgent update and the one that can wait need to be two different values. query updates normally, and the list gets a lagging copy from useDeferredValue.

The key part is moving the list into a memo component. Without it, every urgent render runs filterProducts anyway and deferring buys nothing. For memo to hold, the caller has to keep the products array referentially stable.

turns.user: fixed. but 0.5 is so faint it looks like the list vanished. go 0.8
